objections.claim_attacked: post_state: Reporter re-ran the mock-array repro with a82361ce and saw no false timing violations
objections.objection: The prior_state and title concern megaboom, but the only post-fix confirmation is on the mock-array repro, so the record does not establish that the committed OpenSTA change resolves the original megaboom floorplan violations.

objections.claim_attacked: chosen_intervention: OpenSTA now removes liberty min/max_clock_tree_path delays ... when context uses ideal clocks
objections.objection: The record itself quotes jjcherry56 saying the fix 'will not be exactly the same as using a separate model built with ideal clocks but it should eliminate the bulk of the differences', so the intervention is acknowledged to leave residual error and cannot fully explain a claim of no false violations.

mechanism_check: HOLDS — removing liberty clock-tree delays from macro-model setup/hold and clock-to-output times under ideal-clock contexts directly addresses the hypothesized contamination of those times by propagated-clock macro models.
evidence_check: MEAS — the reporter's re-run of the mock-array repro is a qualitative measurement of no false timing violations, though no quantified QoR or runtime delta is given.
attribution_check: WEAK — the direct_quote names parallaxsw with a date and locator and supports the propagated-clock contamination hypothesis, but it does not support the chosen jjcherry56 commit or the merge into OpenROAD.
missing_from_story: A megaboom retest after the fix, since the only confirmation is on mock-array.
Quantified before/after QoR and runtime numbers for the hold-repair false violations.
The residual error magnitude implied by jjcherry56's caveat that the fix is not exactly equivalent to a separate ideal-clock model.
Confirmation that the setup violation example was also removed, not only the hold violations.
most_defensible_part: The parallaxsw direct_quote's named participant, date, locator, and clear explanation of how propagated-clock macro timing models contaminate setup/hold times in an ideal-clock context.
